title: Betting Against Beta
one_line: Leverage-constrained investors bid up high-beta assets, so a long low-beta / short high-beta (leveraged to beta-neutral) factor earns large risk-adjusted returns across US and international stocks, bonds and futures.

findings.statement: BAB factor Sharpe ≈ 0.78 in US stocks (1926-2012); positive in 18 of 19 countries.
BAB returns fall when funding constraints tighten (TED spread).

reported_results.headline: Leverage-constrained investors bid up high-beta assets, so a long low-beta / short high-beta (leveraged to beta-neutral) factor earns large risk-adjusted returns across US and international stocks, bonds and futures.

tradable_edge: Cross-asset factor; no single-instrument ES/NQ test.
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
